title: Characterization of the Crustacean Methyl Farnesoate Transcriptional Signaling Genes.
authors: Bentley, Vanessa L; Perez-Moreno, Jorge L; Durica, David S; Mykles, Donald L
one_liner_zh: 该文对甲壳动物甲基法尼酯信号通路转录因子进行系统发育与序列注释，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: Methyl farnesoate (MF) is a sesquiterpenoid hormone that controls a variety of physiological processes in crustaceans, including morphogenesis, development, reproduction, and molting. MF action is mediated by a transcriptional signaling cascade consisting of Methoprene-tolerant (Met), Steroid receptor coactivator (Src), Kruppel homolog 1 (Kr-h1), and Ecdysone response gene 93 (E93) transcription factors (TFs), and transcriptional co-regulators CREB-binding protein (CBP) and C-terminal-binding protein (CtBP). Phylogenetic and sequence analyses revealed that these genes were highly conserved across pancrustacean species. Met and Src were characterized as basic helix-loop-helix, Period (Per)-Aryl Hydrocarbon Nuclear Translocator (ARNT)-Single-minded (Sim) protein (bHLH-PAS) TFs; Kr-h1 was characterized as a C(2)H(2) zinc finger TF with seven zinc finger motifs; E93 was characterized as a helix-turn-helix, pipsqueak (HTH_Psq) TF. CBP was identified by several zinc finger-binding regions with Transcription Adaptor Zinc Finger 1 and 2, Really Interesting New Gene, Plant homeodomain, and Z-type zinc finger domains; the Kinase-inducible Domain Interacting-transcription factor docking site; the Bromodomain-acetylated lysine recognition and binding site; the histone acetyltransferase domain; and a C-terminal CREB-binding region containing a nuclear receptor co-activator-binding domain. CtBP had a dehydrogenase domain with arginine-glutamate-histidine catalytic triad. 81 Met contigs, 45 Src contigs, 136 Kr-h1 contigs, 66 E93 contigs, 60 CBP contigs, and 172 CtBP contigs were identified across pancrustacean taxa, including decapod crustaceans. Bioinformatic identification and annotation of these TFs and co-regulators in brachyuran Y-organ (YO) transcriptomes suggests that MF signaling influences YO ecdysteroidogenesis; functional tests in the YO are needed to establish causality.
abstract_zh: 法尼酸甲酯（MF）是一种倍半萜类激素，控制甲壳动物中的多种生理过程，包括形态发生、发育、繁殖和蜕皮。MF的作用由转录信号级联介导，该级联由耐甲氧普林（Met）、类固醇受体共激活因子（Src）、Kruppel同源物1（Kr-h1）和蜕皮激素反应基因93（E93）转录因子（TFs）以及转录共调节因子CREB结合蛋白（CBP）和C端结合蛋白（CtBP）组成。系统发育和序列分析显示，这些基因在泛甲壳动物物种中高度保守。Met和Src被表征为碱性螺旋-环-螺旋、周期蛋白（Per）-芳烃受体核转位蛋白（ARNT）-单-minded蛋白（Sim）转录因子（bHLH-PAS）；Kr-h1被表征为具有七个锌指基序的C(2)H(2)锌指转录因子；E93被表征为螺旋-转角-螺旋、pipsqueak（HTH_Psq）转录因子。CBP通过多个锌指结合区域被识别，包括转录适配器锌指1和2、真正感兴趣的新基因、植物同源结构域和Z型锌指结构域；激酶诱导结构域相互作用转录因子对接位点；溴结构域-乙酰化赖氨酸识别和结合位点；组蛋白乙酰转移酶结构域；以及包含核受体共激活因子结合结构域的C端CREB结合区域。CtBP具有一个含有精氨酸-谷氨酸-组氨酸催化三联体的脱氢酶结构域。在泛甲壳动物类群中，包括十足目甲壳动物，共鉴定出81个Met重叠群、45个Src重叠群、136个Kr-h1重叠群、66个E93重叠群、60个CBP重叠群和172个CtBP重叠群。对短尾类Y器官（YO）转录组中这些转录因子和共调节因子的生物信息学鉴定和注释表明，MF信号影响YO的蜕皮激素生成；需要在YO中进行功能测试以建立因果关系。
